name: Takara Standard Co.,Ltd.
summary: Takara Standard Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells housing equipment and fixtures in Japan. It offers kitchen products, including enamel, wooden, and compact kitchen systems; enamel kitchen panels, heating equipment, and range hoods; bathroom products comprising bath system, shower units, and standalone bathtubs. The company also provides bathroom vanity products, such as enamel vanity, wooden vanity, compact hand wash, enamel clean wash panels, residential toilet panels, enamel clean toilet panels, hand washing basins, and various storage devices.
